articles.title: 29 years after his disappearance from Army's custody, J&K court declares Abdul Rashid Wani dead
articles.summary: A Srinagar court has declared Abdul Rashid Wani legally dead, nearly 29 years after his alleged disappearance from Indian Army custody. This significant verdict by a special mobile magistrate resolves a long-pending case, highlighting legal procedures for missing persons and the complexities of accountability involving security forces. Such cases underscore the challenges in addressing historical disappearances in regions like Kashmir.

articles.title: Rajnath Singh to visit Germany, defence investor summit in focus
articles.summary: India's Defence Minister Rajnath Singh is set to visit Germany this month for high-level interactions. The visit aims to foster deeper defence industry collaboration, focusing on attracting German investment into India's defence sector. Discussions will likely include potential joint ventures, technology transfers, and strategic partnerships, bolstering India's 'Make in India' defence initiatives and strengthening bilateral ties in the security domain.

articles.title: A new (and same old) Patrick Reed is back at the Masters
articles.summary: Prominent golfer Pat Reed is making a comeback to the PGA Tour in late August, following a four-year stint with LIV Golf. This highly anticipated return marks a "fresh start" for Reed, exiting what's been termed Brian Rolapps' "penalty box," and rejoins the established tour, signifying a significant shift in his professional career.

articles.title: Why Cooper Raiff Is Mounting an Emmy Campaign for Lili Reinhart
articles.summary: During the recent awards season, actors Cooper Raiff and Lili Reinhart reportedly crashed a glitzy reception for "Song Sung Blue," a biopic for which Kate Hudson later won an Oscar. This incident highlights the dynamic social scene within the international film industry's high-profile events, offering a glimpse into celebrity interactions during prestigious award ceremonies.

articles.title: Building a high-volume metrics pipeline with OpenTelemetry and vmagent
articles.summary: This article outlines a production-tested approach for migrating large-scale metrics pipelines, specifically detailing the transition from StatsD to modern monitoring systems like OpenTelemetry and Prometheus. Authored by Eugene Ma and Natasha Aleksandrova, it addresses key considerations and methods for updating core monitoring infrastructure. Such advancements are vital for maintaining robust system performance and efficient data analytics in various tech environments.

articles.title: 5 Most Underrated Game Boy Games Ever
articles.summary: The Nintendo Game Boy is celebrated as one of history's most successful handheld video game consoles, featuring an extensive game library across its original and Game Boy Color versions. Its profound impact on portable entertainment and the gaming industry is significant, influencing numerous players and subsequent device innovations. This iconic gadget solidified its legacy, offering a vast array of titles and becoming a cornerstone of technological and gaming culture.
